name: bakery-yard
title: Pităria lavrei (curtea brutăriei, cu cuptorul)
units: engine units (figure 4.2 tall), three.js Y-up, +Z towards the usual camera

table.note: behind the kneading table, over the trough (the film puts `dough-trough` on the table at [tx, tz - 0.35], y 1.55), facing the camera

table-r.note: behind the table, right of the trough (over the shaped loaves), facing the camera

table-front.note: in front of the table, facing it (and the kneaders)

bench.note: beside the bench, facing it (put a sack on the bench at [-8.6, 1.6], y 0.9)

oven-side.note: beside the oven on the table side, facing the mouth (a helper watching / holding the basket)

yard.note: the middle of the yard (the acting area)

center.note: the front of the yard, towards the camera

path-near.note: on the path from the cells (left), facing along it towards the yard

path-mid.note: on the path from the cells (left), facing along it towards the yard

path-far.note: on the path from the cells (left), facing along it towards the yard

offstage-left.note: out of frame on the path, left (enter walking +X)

notes: Bakery yard: house (AI pitarie-casa) at [-15.5, -12.5]; kneading table [-3.0, -2.9], top 1.55 (col:table + legs); the oven prop goes at [7.2, -6.2] face -25 (`bread-oven`).
